transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you please tell me what brings you in to see me today?

I've been feeling incredibly depressed and empty inside for about eight months now. I just feel constantly down and find myself crying all the time for no real reason. It feels like this deep sadness is never going to go away.
Have you ever experienced periods where your mood significantly shifts, becoming either extremely happy, irritable, or restless, even if only for a short time?
No, I've never had any periods where I felt extremely happy or restless. My mood has just been consistently low, sad, and empty for the last eight months.

Can you tell me if you've experienced any periods of time, either before or during the last eight months, where you felt relatively normal or not depressed, or has it been a constant feeling of sadness?

It has been a constant, unchanging feeling of sadness the entire time. There haven't been any breaks or periods where I felt normal at all over these past eight months. Every single day just feels exactly the same—heavy and completely dark.
How long did you experience depressive symptoms before the past eight months, or is this the first time you've felt this way?

This is the first time I've ever felt this way. Before these past eight months, I had never experienced any kind of depression or sadness like this. It all just started eight months ago and hasn't let up since.
Did your depressive symptoms last for less than two years before coming here, or have you been experiencing these feelings for more than two years now?
It has been less than two years. These feelings only started about eight months ago, so it hasn't been going on for nearly that long. It has just been during this recent period.
Have you noticed any significant changes in your daily activities, social interactions, or interest in things you used to enjoy since you started feeling depressed?

I haven't really noticed any major changes in my interests or social interactions, or at least I'm not really sure. Mostly, I'm just consumed by this constant feeling of sadness and emptiness every day.

Can you tell me how your depressive symptoms have affected your daily life, and have you had any periods of at least two months where your symptoms were less severe, even if you still felt some depression?

No, my depression has been completely continuous and unremitting for the entire eight months, without any periods of feeling even slightly better. As for my daily life, it's hard to describe the impact other than feeling constantly drained of all energy.
Have you experienced depressive symptoms for more than two years in total, considering your entire life, or is this current episode your first and only experience with such symptoms?

My current symptoms have only been going on for about eight months. I'm not really sure if I have a history of this lasting for over two years in the past, but this is definitely the first time it has ever been this bad.
Did you experience any depressive symptoms for two years or more at any point in your life before this current episode, or is eight months the longest you've experienced these feelings?

Yes, this current eight-month period is definitely the longest I have ever felt this way in my entire life. I have never experienced these depressive symptoms for two years or more at any point before this.

Since you've had depressive symptoms for less than two years and this is your first episode of this severity, can you think of any stressful events or significant changes in your life that may have triggered the onset of your depressive symptoms about eight months ago?

I honestly can't think of any specific stressful event or major change in my life that happened eight months ago. The depression just seemed to start completely out of nowhere without any obvious cause. It just came on suddenly and hasn't let up since.
